hero.altEn: A dimming sun pressed beneath Saturn's rings in a deep indigo sky, evoking duty-versus-vitality tension at the core of astrological burnout

inline.afterHeadingEn: ## How to Read Burnout Signatures in Your Chart
inline.titleEn: Four Steps to Spot Burnout Patterns in Your Chart
inline.altEn: Four-step sequence: locate Sun and Saturn, scan the sixth house, watch lunar timing, then track repeating low periods

items.subEn: Note the aspect between them — a square or opposition points to the duty-versus-vitality tension most often read as burnout
Count the planets there and note the ruling sign; a crowded sixth house reads as daily demands stacking up fast
Notice when your drive dips most across a month and compare those dips to the lunar cycle, especially around the full moon
Log two or three low periods; if they cluster around the same transits, you are looking at a pattern, not a one-off

inline.altEn: Comparison of Saturn–Sun tension, sixth-house depletion, and lunar-cycle timing as three distinct burnout signatures in a birth chart
